answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after a long history of useful, verifiable work, so creating thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of bonds. A shared cipher-signed work log ties each completed task to one keypair, making reputation non-transferable: like cedar growing slowly and basalt resisting erosion, trust accumulates gradually and cannot be bought in bulk, so an attacker must pay real capital and time per identity.
